children: Sunbelt Rentals reported record fiscal first-quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with total revenue of $3,115 million and net income of $438 million. The company delivered operating income of $691 million and adjusted EBITDA of $1,315 million while raising its full-year fiscal 2027 guidance. Management cited strong demand across specialty lines, mega projects and events as drivers of performance.
Total revenue: $3,115 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (up 11.2%).
Gross profit: $1,249 million (reported gross profit on the condensed consolidated statement of income).
Operating income: $691 million; operating income margin 22.2%.
Net income: $438 million; basic and diluted EPS $1.07 for the quarter.
Adjusted EBITDA: $1,315 million; adjusted EBITDA margin 42.2%. Adjusted EPS: $1.18.
Rental revenue reached a record $2,927 million, increasing 12.5%; North America Specialty rental revenue rose 25.3% while North America General Tool rental revenue rose 7.4%.

Acquisition of Reliant Asset Management (Aries brand) closed May 1, 2026 and contributed approximately 100 basis points to total rental revenue growth and ~300 basis points to Specialty growth in the quarter.
Company estimates the FIFA World Cup contributed roughly 250 basis points to rental revenue growth, underscoring strength in complex events and live-event solutions.

Fleet and operations: original cost of rental equipment totaled $20,102 million with average fleet age of 52 months; dollar utilization was 47% in General Tool, 77% in Specialty and 54% in the UK segment.

Capital deployment and footprint expansion: opened 13 greenfield locations, completed two bolt-on acquisitions (including Aries), invested $669 million including acquired borrowings, and announced increased FY27 capital expenditure expectations.
